sampling_frame: P1 reported sort -R over SEV-1/2/3 inventory IDs before reading them, with ten defect IDs represented here and two separate confirmed-good checks. Four Tier-1 IDs were selected for impact. No raw randomization seed/draw receipt or full finite sampling-frame size was provided to C.
core_definition: Direct actionable defect in the specified mechanism at the evidenced layer. A true signature or trusted interface without the alleged reachable unauthorized path is not a confirmed security defect.
material_error_definition: Directly contradicted trigger/scope/cause that changes remediation or impact classification. Unproven impact and immaterial exception syntax are not counted as false.

decided_only_core_sensitivity.note: Drops unresolved S26, which need not be missing at random.

interval_method: 95% Wilson score, z=1.959963984540054, no finite-population correction because exact population and draw not independently verified. Conditional on claimed sampling scheme; not a precision guarantee for the approximately 85 remainder.
